# nemau storage volume

Manage block volumes.

## Usage

```
nemau storage volume [command]
```

Aliases: `volumes`, `vol`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [attach](nemau_storage_volume_attach.md) | Attach a volume to an instance |
| [create](nemau_storage_volume_create.md) | Create a volume |
| [delete](nemau_storage_volume_delete.md) | Delete a volume |
| [detach](nemau_storage_volume_detach.md) | Detach a volume from an instance |
| [extend](nemau_storage_volume_extend.md) | Extend a volume |
| [list](nemau_storage_volume_list.md) | List the volumes |
| [update](nemau_storage_volume_update.md) | Change a volume's name or description |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
